text: I bought this hoping I could adjust the clock settings. Unfortunately, the timer is mirrored compared to a regular clock: the circle starts at 55 and ends at 5. This feels illogical to my brain, and I can’t get used to it. After purchasing, there is no refund, not even aftwr 5 minutes. The rest of the app looks nice.
author: Maya Borneman - van Vlimmeren
developer_reply: Thanks for your feedback! Our design makes time visible, helping users understand what 10, 20, or 60 minutes feels like. Counterclockwise numbers align with the red disk’s clockwise movement to show remaining time at a glance. Need help? support@timetimer.com
